mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, owner_id AS ownerId, original_name AS originalName, content_type AS contentType, size_bytes AS size, sha256, storage_id AS storageId, bucket, object_key AS objectKey, object_version AS objectVersion, etag, status, error_code AS errorCode FROM file_asset WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_asset (file_id, owner_id, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, storage_id, bucket, object_key, status) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{ownerId}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{storageId}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE file_asset SET sha256 = #{sha256}, object_version = #{objectVersion}, etag = #{etag}, status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
